_approach: Polyrhythm construction from the Samplesound groove lesson: the high percussion accents every third 16th (groups of 3-3-3-3-4) so six accents cross the four straight kicks, while the shaker keeps a plain 8th pulse as the reference. In bar 2 the 3-grouping migrates to the clave and the conga fills the gaps. Ref: &ME 'Solaris' (2019), Rampa 'Necesito' (2020). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
